url_verifier OK (200 + 'Narimanam'/'Cauvery' present). Oil & Gas Journal: 'Six ... sodium silicate plants to be fed by Cauvery gas are under construction or on stream in the Narimanam area' — ties Cauvery-basin field gas directly to the Narimanam consumer end of this network.

resolutions.researcher_notes: FuelSource='Cauvery Gas Fields' is supported by two independent trade-press sources describing gas produced in/from the Cauvery Basin being delivered through this GAIL network to consumers around Narimanam/Kuthalam. Both are independent of each other and of any GEM/regulatory lineage.

EndLocation='Narimanam'/Tamil Nadu is well supported (PNGRB 2009 letter: 'Narimanam and Kuthalam interconnected pipeline sub-network'; Energy News Bulletin: pipeline 'to connect the Narimanam Z[one]...'; OGJ: sodium-silicate plants 'fed by Cauvery gas ... in the Narimanam area'). But I could NOT find support for StartLocation='Offshore', and what I found points the other way: the 2009 authorization letter's Annexe-I names the network's upstream tie-in points as onshore ONGC Gas Collecting Stations (e.g. 'ONGCL GCS-GAIL GCS', 'ONGC GCS-KUTHALAM', 'ONGCL-NALLUR'), and Oil & Gas Journal states that 'with the exception of Hardy Oil & Gas, which operates the offshore PY-3 oil field, ONGC is the sole producer in the Cauvery Basin with all its production located onshore' — i.e. the fields actually feeding this specific GAIL common-carrier network (Narimanam/Kuthalam/Ramnad zones) appear to be onshore, not offshore. Per the standing rule against proposing refs for a different value, I am NOT proposing a StartLocation change — flagging this as a possible sheet defect worth a follow-up Update-workflow look rather than citing a ref that would misrepresent 'Offshore' as sourced. Leaving UNRESOLVED.
